newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds seek temporary push up to 114-00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds seek temporary push up to 114-00.

text.p: September T-bond futures were set to push slightly higher on Friday but further out more declines are on the way, technical analysts said.
"Today if anything I expect a jab up towards 114-00 continuing the rebound from 111-31," said Howard Friend, senior technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London.
"But the longer term picture is bearish," he said.
At 0919 GMT, September T-bond futures were at 113-21, up 1/32 in automated trade.
Friend said once the contract slipped to 113-08, a higher low on hourly charts, it would signal the end of the rally and open the way for a move down to 111-31 again.
Daily charts show T-bonds formed a low at 111-31 on August 13.
Ian Murphy, head of futures sales at Royal Bank of Scotland also expected an eventual fall towards 111-14.
That level marks a 50 percent retracement of the rally from 105-30 in mid-April to 116-31 at the end of July.
Along the way he noted support at 112-16 and below there at 112-10, 08 around the target of a bear flag pattern which T-bonds closed at last Friday.
But first, he said T-bonds had some scope to move higher.
"The current consolidation phase is expected to react to the retracements to the last part of the sell-off from 115-06 to the low at 112-08," he said in a note to clients.
That move marked the sharp decline of August 7 and 8. The 50 percent retracement of that move comes in at 113-23.
"If T-bonds can rally into this area then this is viewed as a selling opportunity," Murphy said.
At the short end December Eurodollar futures were at 94.105, up 0.010 on the day.
